style: Style: modern Japanese woodblock print (shin-hanga inspired), flat layered colour areas, fine carved outlines, gentle gradients (bokashi) in the sky, slightly textured washi paper grain, calm and elegant palette. Wide landscape composition for a travel guide cover. No text, no letters, no signage, no logos, no watermark, no people in close-up.
